workers.title: Workers
workers.description: Laptops and desktops registered to run plan steps for their owner. A worker sends a heartbeat every 15 seconds; after 5 minutes without one it is offline, and the runs it held go back to the queue.

register.title: Register a worker
register.description: The worker makes outbound HTTPS calls only and pulls its own work. No port is opened on the machine.
register.name: Worker name
register.nameHint: Unique among your workers: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. The machine's hostname works well.
register.nameRequired: Enter a name for the worker.
register.nameInvalid: Start with a letter or digit, then use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, at most 100 in all.
register.projectsHint: Only projects where you hold the writer role are listed. The worker never gets a run from a project outside this list.
register.projectsFailed: The project list could not be loaded. Close the dialog and try again.
register.noProjects: You hold the writer role on no project yet, so a worker would have nothing to run. Ask a project admin for the writer role.
register.slotsHint: Runs it holds at the same time, {min} to {max}.
register.slotsInvalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
register.labelsHint: Optional. Separate them with commas or spaces.
register.labelsInvalid: Not a valid label: {labels}. A label starts with a letter or digit and holds letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, at most 40 in all.
register.terminalHint: Lets you open a shell on this machine from a run's page on the hub. Leave it off unless you need it.
register.warning: Agents on a worker run with your full permissions on that machine, not in a sandbox. Register only machines where that is acceptable. Only you can dispatch runs to it.
